courses.title: Courses Completed
courses.description: Here are some of the courses I have completed to enhance my skills and knowledge in various areas.

curso1.title: PYTHON COMPLETE: From Zero to Advanced (Become a Programmer)
curso1.description: Complete Python course from zero to advanced, focusing on practical projects, data structures, functions, and file handling.

curso2.title: Front-end Development Training - HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, and More
curso2.description: Front-end development training from beginner to advanced, including HTML and CSS for responsive interfaces, advanced JavaScript, React with hooks, and TypeScript in modern projects.

curso3.title: Hardware Course - Computer Assembly and Maintenance
curso3.description: Hardware training covering computer assembly and maintenance, emphasizing component identification, selecting appropriate parts, proper assembly, and installing Windows 11.

curso4.title: Practical IT Support
curso4.description: Practical IT support course covering problem identification and resolution, user support, virtual machine creation, HD cloning, basic server knowledge, Active Directory, and interview preparation.

curso5.title: Learn Microsoft POWER BI in 7 Days + Real Projects
curso5.description: Practical Power BI training covering creation of professional-quality reports and dashboards, data preparation and integration from multiple sources, data modeling with DAX, interactive dashboards, and continuous report sharing with stakeholders.

curso6.title: RPA for Everyone: Build Your Robots with Automation Anywhere
curso6.description: RPA course with Automation Anywhere, learning to create bots to automate repetitive tasks, develop workflows, and optimize business processes for greater efficiency.

curso7.title: SQL Server Course
curso7.description: Complete SQL training covering relational database concepts, table creation and management, advanced queries, functions, joins, stored procedures, and system integration.

curso8.title: Node.js from Zero to Mastery with Multiple Projects
curso8.description: Node.js training from fundamentals to advanced projects, including API creation with Express, MVC architecture, integration with MySQL and MongoDB, and using ORMs (Sequelize and Mongoose) for scalable applications.

curso9.title: C# Complete Course: From Beginner to Advanced
curso9.description: Complete C# course from beginner to advanced, focusing on program development, object-oriented programming, collections, lambdas, generics, dynamics, and other language features.

curso10.title: Active Directory Specialization - Windows Server 2022
curso10.description: Active Directory and Windows Server 2022 training, covering user and group management, Microsoft domain implementation, network infrastructure setup, and virtualized environments using Hyper-V.

curso11.title: Microsoft Power BI for Business Intelligence and Data Science
curso11.description: Advanced Power BI course for Business Intelligence and Data Science, with practical projects, data modeling, interactive dashboards, and application of Machine Learning techniques for data analysis.
